question: Does independent cheap-agent diversity improve sustained project quality over a matched sequential revision chain, and does generated evidence identify the useful alternatives?

controller.ceiling_scope: All listed call/repair/review/scout/proposal ceilings apply per stage. Exactly four initial call opportunities in each matched policy, including invalid/no-op known outcomes. Unknown provider outcomes halt globally without further calls.
controller.repair_models: Cheap normal repairs for both matched arms, strong for the anchor; at most one shared strong stall escalation within ordinary repair/review limits.
controller.probe_quotas: Per-stage independent quotas: at most8 admitted scout probes and8 admitted reviewer probes; rejected proposals consume generation opportunities, not admission slots.

candidate_formation: Sequential-four gives each subsequent cheap builder the preceding retained source and its executed public/prior-stage evidence, preserving all four checkpoints for selection. Independent-four gives all four the identical stage-start source without peer outputs. Initial call counts and model/token ceilings match, actual usage need not. Invalid/no-op serial proposals retain prior source eligibility; no new correctness is inferred. Both use identical reviewer, repair and escalation rules.
scout_visibility: Scouts run only after all initial candidates for their stage are durably frozen. They receive the stage-start source, cumulative public contract and public cases, not candidates, peer probes, private cases or fault bank. Their oracle-gated probes are then applied to every candidate before the common reviewer. Prior-stage admitted probes remain regression evidence. Test utility is therefore separable from prevention in current-stage initial generation.
primary: Whole project explicitly completed at both milestones and exact final source independently passes all cumulative public, admitted and private acceptance cases.
secondary: Paired whole-project acceptance and requirement-group coverage
Earlier requirements retained after later changes
Best available first/final pool quality versus selected quality
Public-only versus scout/reviewer evidence selection on the same frozen pool
Public-surviving semantic fault families detected, unique probe contribution and redundancy
Effective repairs, regressions, stagnation and bounded stops
Active time, provider span union, verification time and API token cost
fault_bank: Freeze per-stage semantic mutants and correct/semantics-preserving controls before any live call. Qualify golden and control correctness, classify every mutant by public survival and independent witness failures. Never reveal faults/witnesses or fault scores to workers. Count distinct families. Execute generated suites against all same-project stage sources and faults only after the complete provider cohort freezes.

barriers.before_live: All affected offline gates, fixture Docker qualification, and an exact complete zero-API rehearsal under frozen plan/source/runtime/image/model limits.
barriers.private: All ten terminal trajectories, every candidate source, proposal and final selection frozen before any private/fault/cross-policy diagnostic execution.
barriers.audit: Independent source, receipt, roster, journal, accounting, timing and Git audit before reporting final scores.

budget.headroom: Strong calls reserve approximately $5.52648; realized spend cannot consume the full remaining balance while preserving future strong dispatch. Keep existing conservative reservations, serialize strong calls, censor bounded/unexecuted work honestly. No cap reset or automatic retry.

execution.provider_journal: Existing RequestJournal; unknown outcomes halt without retry
execution.rehearsal: Scripted source/probe/review controls including no-op preservation and common-controller stagnation; no provider calls
execution.historical_sources: Existing frozen fixtures/controllers/runners remain byte-identical; new scientific behavior is versioned.

transport_scope: Separate deterministic zero-API artifact dissemination stress comparison: peer gossip, durable single broker with persisted restart, and explicitly replicated/failover broker. Equal attempted contact budget includes replication. Measures local evidence availability and safety under specified faults, not improved model reasoning or a live decentralized coding policy.

interpretation.matched: Only sequential-four versus independent-four has matched initial builder opportunities. Both are centrally instrumented policies; this isolates candidate diversity rather than gossip transport.
interpretation.anchor: Two strong-anchor trajectories provide context, not a compute-matched or equally replicated contrast.
interpretation.ranking: Descriptive within-project paired win/draw/loss; acceptance first, coverage second; no calibrated Elo and no treating derived pairwise comparisons as independent games.
interpretation.timing: Active trajectory elapsed excludes whole-cohort freeze waiting. Early incomplete runs never win a speed ranking. Provider, Docker and active spans overlap and are not additive.
interpretation.generalization: Two maintained synthetic applications, two repetitions per matched policy, oracle-assisted labels and small cohort. Outcomes can falsify local hypotheses but cannot establish general superiority.

analysis_protocol.pairing: Same project and repetition, not shared provider randomness. Four paired trajectory blocks but only two application domains. Anchors unpaired.
analysis_protocol.source_pools: Preserve all attempt checkpoint identities; deduplicate execution by exact source hash within stage and purpose. Analyze initial and final eligible slot pools separately; best-ever retained source is a separately labeled ceiling.
analysis_protocol.counterfactual_selector: Require original source eligibility and every public case passing, otherwise abstain. Rank eligible public-passing candidates by number of passing extra tests from the named evidence set descending, then the frozen anonymized candidate order ascending. Public-only uses no extras. Deduplicate exact inputs and reject conflicting expectations. No private outcomes enter selection or ties.
analysis_protocol.regret: Gap in private requirement-group coverage between best available pool member and selected source, plus available-perfect-but-selected-imperfect counts. Best-ever source ceiling separately labeled.
analysis_protocol.qualification_exception: Trusted golden/control/mutant fixtures may execute for pre-live qualification. No model-generated private, cross-policy or fault diagnostic before all live provider sources/selections freeze.
analysis_protocol.censor: If budget cannot reserve the next planned call, halt without automatic retry; retain partially executed and unexecuted roster. Do not treat unexecuted as correctness failure or publish completed-cohort scores. No private diagnostics unless every planned trajectory is terminal.
analysis_protocol.evidence_scope: Counterfactual selectors are reported separately with own-history and pooled same-project/stage evidence. Pooled cross-policy evidence was unavailable during live decisions and is not a separately executed agent policy.
